title.value: Is sharing always caring? Entropy, boundaries and the plurality of psychotherapeutic process: Comment on “Nature heals: An informational entropy account of self-organization and change in field psychotherapy” by P. Sarasso et al.
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Is sharing always caring? Entropy, boundaries and the plurality of psychotherapeutic process: Comment on “Nature heals: An informational entropy account of self-organization and change in field psychotherapy” by P. Sarasso et al.

analysis.description: This paper provides a commentary on the work by Sarasso et al., discussing the application of the Free Energy Principle (FEP) in understanding psychotherapeutic change. It emphasizes a perspective on psychotherapeutic change by integrating concepts such as entropy and synergetics, and critiques the broad application of theoretical models like FEP without sufficient specificity.

type.quote: Sarasso et al. propose an ambitious perspective on psychotherapeutic change, combining concepts from the Free Energy Principle (FEP), synergetics, and neurophenomenology.
